# Polar

> Payments & Billing with 6 lines of code. Open Source & Global Merchant of Record.

- [subscription.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_updated.md): Sent when a subscription is updated. This event fires for all changes to the subscription, including renewals.
- [subscription.canceled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_canceled.md): Sent when a subscription is canceled. Customers might still have access until the end of the current period.
- [subscription.uncanceled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_uncanceled.md): Sent when a customer revokes a pending cancellation.
- [subscription.cycled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_cycled.md): Sent when a subscription enters a new billing period.
- [subscription.revoked](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_revoked.md): Sent when a subscription is revoked and the user loses access immediately. Happens when the subscription is canceled or payment retries are exhausted (status becomes `unpaid`).
- [subscription.past_due](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-04/subscription_past_due.md): Sent when a subscription payment fails and the subscription enters `past_due` status.

- [Revoke Seat](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_portal/revoke-seat.md)
- [Resend Invitation](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_portal/resend-invitation.md)
- [List Claimed Subscriptions](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_portal/list-claimed-subscriptions.md): List all subscriptions where the authenticated customer has claimed a seat.
- [List Customer Payment Methods](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_portal/list-customer-payment-methods.md): Get saved payment methods of the authenticated customer.
- [Delete Customer Payment Method](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_portal/delete-customer-payment-method.md): Delete a payment method from the authenticated customer.
- [customer.state_changed](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_state_changed.md): Sent when a customer state has changed.
- [customer.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_created.md): Sent when a new customer is created.
- [customer.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_updated.md): Sent when a customer is updated.
- [customer.deleted](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_deleted.md): Sent when a customer is deleted.
- [checkout.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/checkout_created.md): Sent when a new checkout is created.
- [checkout.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/checkout_updated.md): Sent when a checkout is updated.
- [checkout.expired](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/checkout_expired.md): Sent when a checkout expires.
- [subscription.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_created.md): Sent when a new subscription is created.
- [subscription.active](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_active.md): Sent when a subscription becomes active, whether because it's a new paid subscription or because payment was recovered.
- [subscription.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_updated.md): Sent when a subscription is updated. This event fires for all changes to the subscription, including renewals.
- [subscription.canceled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_canceled.md): Sent when a subscription is canceled. Customers might still have access until the end of the current period.
- [subscription.uncanceled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_uncanceled.md): Sent when a customer revokes a pending cancellation.
- [subscription.cycled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_cycled.md): Sent when a subscription enters a new billing period.
- [subscription.revoked](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_revoked.md): Sent when a subscription is revoked and the user loses access immediately. Happens when the subscription is canceled or payment retries are exhausted (status becomes `unpaid`).
- [subscription.past_due](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_past_due.md): Sent when a subscription payment fails and the subscription enters `past_due` status.
- [subscription.paused](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_paused.md): Sent when a subscription is paused and the customer temporarily loses access.
- [subscription.resumed](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/subscription_resumed.md): Sent when a paused subscription resumes, restoring the customer's access.
- [order.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/order_created.md): Sent when a new order is created.
- [order.paid](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/order_paid.md): Sent when an order is paid.
- [order.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/order_updated.md): Sent when an order is updated.
- [order.refunded](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/order_refunded.md): Sent when an order is fully or partially refunded.
- [customer_seat.assigned](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_seat_assigned.md): Sent when a new customer seat is assigned.
- [customer_seat.claimed](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_seat_claimed.md): Sent when a customer seat is claimed.
- [customer_seat.revoked](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/customer_seat_revoked.md): Sent when a customer seat is revoked.
- [refund.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/refund_created.md): Sent when a refund is created regardless of status.
- [refund.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/refund_updated.md): Sent when a refund is updated.
- [benefit_grant.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_grant_created.md): Sent when a new benefit grant is created.
- [benefit_grant.cycled](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_grant_cycled.md): Sent when a benefit grant is cycled, meaning the related subscription has been renewed for another period.
- [benefit_grant.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_grant_updated.md): Sent when a benefit grant is updated.
- [benefit_grant.revoked](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_grant_revoked.md): Sent when a benefit grant is revoked.
- [benefit.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_created.md): Sent when a new benefit is created.
- [benefit.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/benefit_updated.md): Sent when a benefit is updated.
- [product.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/product_created.md): Sent when a new product is created.
- [product.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/product_updated.md): Sent when a product is updated.
- [discount.created](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/discount_created.md): Sent when a new discount is created.
- [discount.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/discount_updated.md): Sent when a discount is updated.
- [discount.deleted](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/discount_deleted.md): Sent when a discount is deleted.
- [organization.updated](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/organization_updated.md): Sent when a organization is updated.
- [Authorize](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/oauth2/authorize.md)
- [Request Token](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/oauth2/request-token.md): Request an access token using a valid grant.
- [Introspect Token](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/oauth2/introspect-token.md): Get information about an access token.
- [Revoke Token](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/oauth2/revoke-token.md): Revoke an access token or a refresh token.
- [Get User Info](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/oauth2/get-user-info.md): Get information about the authenticated user.
- [Create Webhook Endpoint](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/webhooks/create-webhook-endpoint.md): Create a webhook endpoint.
- [Get Webhook Endpoint](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/webhooks/get-webhook-endpoint.md): Get a webhook endpoint by ID.
- [List Webhook Endpoints](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/webhooks/list-webhook-endpoints.md): List webhook endpoints.
- [Update Webhook Endpoint](https://polar.sh/docs/api-reference/2026-10/webhooks/update-webhook-endpoint.md): Update a webhook endpoint.
